effect_applied.description: null when it is unknown whether the effect took place
effect_applied.title: Effect Applied

params_schema.description: JSON Schema of the parameter object
params_schema.title: Params Schema

ArtifactRef.description: Pointer to a large object held by an ArtifactStore (never inlined into events).

uri.description: object location, e.g. file://… or s3://bucket/key
uri.title: Uri

ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef

value.description: value the plan assumed (null for free UNKNOWN locations)
value.title: Value

AssumptionSet.description: Everything a belief-based conclusion assumed beyond fresh observations (P2-025).
AssumptionSet.title: AssumptionSet

BudgetUsage.description:
Usage counters. `model_calls` counts calls that returned a usable response; `model_attempts` every request
sent (incl. failures and lost responses); tokens are only what the provider reported — calls without usage data
are counted in `unreported_calls`, calls whose response was lost in `unconfirmed_calls`.
BudgetUsage.title: BudgetUsage

belief_applicability.description: applicability judged on the actor's observation (unknown facts stay UNKNOWN)

ConflictInfo.description: Why a proposal based on an older world revision was rejected (shared-resource arbitration).
ConflictInfo.title: ConflictInfo

domain.description: enum or entity set of a symbolic value; required when ambiguous
domain.title: Domain

CostTerm.description:
One additive cost term of an objective level.

- action_cost: `weight` × the declared `cost` of every action taken on the path.
- state_rate: `weight` × `expr` (int) evaluated on every post-state s_1..s_k of the path.
- terminal: `weight` × `expr` (int) evaluated on the final state s_k of the path.
CostTerm.title: CostTerm

expected_by.description: what produced the expectation, e.g. model:<package>@<version>
expected_by.title: Expected By

EvidenceRef.description: Reference to something that supports a claim: an event, artifact, check or snapshot.
EvidenceRef.title: EvidenceRef

evidence.description: basis of `observed`: fresh observation, verified within a stated scope (probe / operation query), or unknown (not comparable); `predicted` marks a value only the model supplies (v2)
evidence.title: Evidence

ObjectiveLevel.description: One lexicographic level: minimise (or maximise) the sum of its terms over the path.
ObjectiveLevel.title: ObjectiveLevel

ObjectiveSpec.description:
What a cost-aware planner optimises (P2-020).

A candidate plan is a path s_0 → … → s_k (k ≤ horizon) that ends in the first state where `goal_property`
holds. Its value on each level is the sum of the level's terms over that path (see `CostTerm`); levels are
compared lexicographically in list order. Costs stop accumulating once the goal holds.
ObjectiveSpec.title: ObjectiveSpec

requested_paths.description: locations observed fresh on request (OBSERVE_MORE, v2)
requested_paths.title: Requested Paths

semantics.default: Facts are what the actor observed (possibly stale, see observed_at_step); unknowns are locations whose current value the actor cannot know at this step. The environment truth state is a separate object that agents never receive.
semantics.title: Semantics

step.description: logical step at which the observation is taken
step.title: Step

turn.description: turn the observation was taken for (v2)

ObservationRequest.description: Extra observations that would settle an UNKNOWN verdict (P2-027).

for_action.description: ground action key the request is about
for_action.title: For Action

ObservationRequest.title: ObservationRequest

QuantExpr.description:
forall/exists → bool, count → number of satisfying members, sum → sum of an int body,
max_over/min_over → largest/smallest int body over the satisfying members (`default` when there is none).

default.description: max_over/min_over only: value when no member qualifies
default.title: Default

domain.description: entity set or enum to range over
domain.title: Domain

QuantExpr.title: QuantExpr

RefExpr.description: Reads an action parameter or a quantifier-bound variable.
RefExpr.title: RefExpr

TurnRef.description: Position of one action in the interleaving: global step g, round r, and the actor's own step count.
TurnRef.title: TurnRef

VarExpr.description: Reads a state variable or a constant table at the given index.
VarExpr.title: VarExpr

goal.description: the actor's goal (participant goal, else joint goal)
goal.title: Goal

last_outcome.description: the actor's previous outcome incl. its effect comparison (plan revision, v2)

observation_request_allowed.description: the environment can answer an ObservationRequest this turn (v2)
observation_request_allowed.title: Observation Request Allowed

participants.description: all actor ids in turn order (v2)
participants.title: Participants

replan_requested.description: reason a REPLAN rule fired for this actor (v2)
replan_requested.title: Replan Requested
